Dear Harriet,

Beacon Works have told us that following their visit on Friday 24 October, your back/garden door is now opening and closing properly after naturally settling, so no repair or charge was needed.

Could you please reply to confirm the door is closing smoothly and no longer creaking? If it is still sticking or the hinges still look out of line, just let us know and we will arrange for it to be looked at again.

If we don't hear from you, we will check in with you again on Friday 31 October before closing the request.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
